digest.component_or_area: test-only timeout windows in subprocess and network sentinels
propositions: test_slow_but_progressing_remote_is_not_aborted uses a 15-second real loopback server and 10-second low-speed window, consuming 15+ seconds wall time per test cell despite the contract being about sustained throughput above floor, not elapsed seconds

test_read_retried_then_terminal uses a 1-second call timeout plus production backoff sleeps across three real child processes, consuming ~9 seconds wall time despite the contract being exactly three attempts, a logical 2s/4s retry schedule, and process cleanup, not elapsed seconds

injecting sub-second test-only windows (1s low-speed window, 0.1s call/grace/drain) into both tests while keeping real sockets and subprocess execution will reduce multi-second test latency without changing production defaults or semantic assertions

each real spawned PID in the ACLI read sentinel must be recorded and polled until absent after terminal failure to prove no child or process group survives, with no brittle wall-clock pass threshold added
